$comment: Plan W4.4 / 15.18. Every VITE_* variable a build may set. Vite inlines VITE_* values into the public bundle, so each name here must be public by design: a URL, a client id, a price id, a public key. A build that sets any other VITE_* name fails (src/build/viteEnvGate.ts), and npm run secrets:scan-live checks the names set in Vercel against this list. Secrets go in the secret store (src/lib/secretStore.ts) or server-side, never here. A value starting with ci-canary- is a CI canary and is allowed under any name.

names.VITE_DROPBOX_APP_KEY: Dropbox OAuth app key (PKCE, no secret)
names.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: Supabase anon key (public; row-level security gates access)

prefixes.VITE_VERCEL_: Vercel system variables (deployment id, git ref and commit). Vercel sets them on every build when 'Automatically expose System Environment Variables' is on; none is a secret, and since #243 the app reads none of them, so they stay out of the bundle.
